summary: Resamples a 3D texture from source to destination dimensions using fixed-point coordinate scaling ((dimension<<16)/dimension). Guards on an object type byte (v1[8] != 2 rejects with -2147467259), allocates two 16-byte staging buffers, samples rows through the source vtable, copies 16-byte texel blocks through an intermediate scanline buffer, and writes through the destination vtable. Frees both staging buffers and returns 0 on success; a failed second allocation frees the first buffer and returns -2147024882.

operations.description: SEHHandlerInit installs the structured exception handler frame for the function.
Guard on object type byte v1[8] != 2; when it is not 2 the function returns -2147467259.
Read source element count from object v1 + 4184 and store it as the allocation size factor.
Allocate the first staging buffer via OperatorNewNhMallocWrapper(16 * elementCount).
Initialize the first staging buffer elements through sub_5008C2 using element constructor sub_5007EC.
Guard on the first allocation result; when null the function returns -2147024882.
Read destination element count from object v2[1] + 4184 for the second allocation.
Allocate and initialize the second staging buffer with the same operator/constructor pair.
Compute fixed-point X scale (sourceDimX << 16) / destDimX; similarly scale Y and Z from source dims 4184/4188/4192 over destination dims v9[1046..1048].
Outer loop over destination Z rows and inner loop over destination X/Y scanlines, accumulating scaled coordinates for source sampling.
Indirect vtable call on the source object (method at vtable offset +4) to fetch a source scanline into the first staging buffer.
Inner copy loop that advances a fixed-point X accumulator and copies 16-byte texel blocks from the source buffer into the destination scanline buffer.
Indirect vtable call on the destination object (method at vtable offset +8) to write the assembled scanline.
Free both staging buffers with FreeWrapper_7bcf after the nested loops complete.
Return 0 on success; the failure branch frees the first buffer and returns -2147024882.
